purpose: Document first-party registry/map discovery, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: Official Côte d'Ivoire sources evidence Korhogo's land-conservation district and current national urban parcel and land-identifier channels. No anonymous complete safe parcel polygon response with a verified native identity was obtained.
registryAssessment: The DGI land-circonscriptions publication explicitly names the circonscription foncière de Korhogo and its Livre foncier de Korhogo. SIGFU is the official urban-land management system with parcel/lot search; IDUFCI describes a national unique parcel identifier. These establish local custody and public procedures/channels, not open citywide parcel geometry.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official DGI publication lists Korhogo as a land-conservation district, assigns it the Korhogo land book, and states the competence area includes the Korhogo department and neighboring departments.
Official SIGFU parcel page describes public locality, lotissement, lot and parcel search and says results concern approved subdivisions; no schema or complete polygon response was retained.
Official SIGFU public landing page describes parcel/lot cartography and administrative land-verification services.
Official IDUFCI page describes a unique identifier intended for every Côte d'Ivoire land parcel and links spatial and textual land information; no public feature response was verified.
Official service portal describes requesting a cadastral section plan from the responsible tax/cadastre office; it is a procedure, not an anonymous parcel geometry API.

viewerConfiguration.observedTechnology: Public HTML/search-indexed viewer material; direct local retrieval of SIGFU was blocked by TLS trust-chain verification. No stable service configuration or API contract was verified.
observedControls: SIGFU public parcel/lot cartography and verification links
viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: Not exposed by bounded retrieval; no CRS, native ID field, or feature schema was verified.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if independently verified

attempts.result: Search result exposed official parcel/locality/lot search controls and approved-subdivision scope; direct bounded feature response, schema and geometry were not obtained.
Official public landing page described parcel/lot cartography and land-verification services; no feature response or schema obtained.
Official publication content verified Korhogo cadastral custody and competence area; no geometry request submitted.
Official IDUFCI description verified the national parcel-identifier framework; no safe anonymous feature response obtained.
Official procedure verified that a section plan is requested from the responsible cadastre service; no geometry request submitted.
TLS certificate chain could not be verified by the local curl trust store; request was not retried with verification disabled or bypassed.

geometryDecision: No full polygon retained; no qualifying safe anonymous parcel response was verified.

geometryEvidence.query: No parcel feature query was submitted because the public pages did not expose a verified anonymous endpoint/schema and the direct SIGFU request encountered a TLS trust-chain failure.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Korhogo cadastral custody plus official Côte d'Ivoire SIGFU and IDUFCI channels.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: No anonymous complete-polygon feature response verified.

remainingUncertainty: The SIGFU and IDUFCI current JavaScript/API routes, anonymous access policy, CRS, native identity field, returned schema, geometry coverage, and citywide completeness remain unverified. Search indexing, TLS failure, and lack of a bounded response are not evidence of cadastral absence.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No independently verified anonymous ID-plus-geometry response; packet does not qualify an adapter or enable runtime.
